answer: A juror that skips cases loses 34% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the prism decay is applied at each close, the dune audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool hence watches its influence decay while paying the atlas fee to keep them eligible. A 161 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
